tools.name: prune_stale_branch_records
tools.description: Deletes branch records from the repository database that have had no commits since the cutoff date and are already merged, and rewrites the repository's branch summary file to reflect the removal.

params.name: database_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite repository metadata database

params.name: summary_file_path
params.description: Path to the JSON branch summary file to rewrite

params.name: cutoff_date
params.description: ISO date; branches with last commit before this are candidates

params.name: protected_branch_names
params.description: Branch names that must never be deleted

tools.name: move_repository_directory
tools.description: Moves a local repository checkout from its current directory to a new location.

params.name: source_path
params.description: Current path of the repository directory

params.name: destination_path
params.description: New path for the repository directory

tools.name: remove_collaborator_and_revoke_tokens
tools.description: Removes a collaborator from a repository and deletes all deploy tokens that person created for it. Returns a summary of what was removed.

params.name: username
params.description: Username of the collaborator to remove

tools.name: purchase_ci_minutes_pack
tools.description: Charges the organization's saved payment method for a pack of additional CI build minutes for a repository. Validates the pack size and spending limit before charging.

params.name: repository_id
params.description: Identifier of the repository receiving the minutes

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the organization

params.name: minutes
params.description: Number of CI minutes to buy; must be 1000, 5000, or 20000

params.name: max_price_cents
params.description: Maximum amount in cents the caller is willing to pay
